title: skills platform catalog: add sys_standard_unit_setting (an organization's display decimals per standard unit code) beside sys_unit
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbdHk3orAeensH6EzS

Filing gate: ① a shipped platform object missing from the generated catalog agents read · Source: fleet (note 7180167601 item 3 on #35490; the #35490 card thread found the row regenerates `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md`, a governed surface its PR stays out of). Follow-up of #35498 / #35490.

Grading: `area:data` · reach: read — `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts` lists `sys_unit` (line ~128) and `sys_exchange_rate` but not `sys_standard_unit_setting`, shipped by PR #37389; an agent building a metadata app reads the generated catalog and does not learn where a standard code's display decimals are set · evidence: read.
Suggested-grade: p3 · docs reach for agents; runtime unaffected.

## What

Add a `sys_standard_unit_setting` row to `platform-catalog.ts` (builds: an organization's display decimal places for a standard unit code; reach: Setup, data API, read by the quantity display from #35490; clearing = deleting the row) and regenerate `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md`. Tier H (`skills/**`).

Related: #35498 (PR #37389), #35490, #37245 (ADR-0158 row 7179515770).
Dedupe: searched 'platform-catalog sys_standard_unit_setting' — only #35490.
